SELECT ks.id, ks.NAME, ks.gender, ks.birthdate, kc.class_name, kg.NAME guardianName, kg.phone guardianPhone, ks.is_weak, ks.special_case FROM kg_student ks LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, GROUP_CONCAT( NAME ) NAME, GROUP_CONCAT( phone ) phone FROM kg_guardian WHERE kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} GROUP BY student_id ) kg ON kg.student_id = ks.id LEFT JOIN kg_classroom kc ON ks.class_id = kc.id WHERE ks.del_flag = 0 AND ks.kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND ks.is_leave_school = 1
AND ks.card_number LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.identityNumber}, '%')
AND ( ks.name LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.info}, '%') OR kg.phone LIKE concat('%', #{queryVO.info}, '%') )
ORDER BY ks.create_time DESC

SELECT
CASE ks.gender WHEN 0 THEN '男' WHEN 1 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END '性别',
IFNULL( ks.nation, '' ) '民族',
IFNULL( ks.health_status, '' ) '健康状况',
IFNULL( ks.card_type, '' ) '证件类型',
IFNULL( ks.card_number, '' ) '证件号码',
IFNULL( kc.class_name, '' ) '班级',
IFNULL( ks.studying_way, '' ) '就读方式',
IFNULL( ks.birthdate, '' ) '出生日期',
IFNULL( ks.native_place, '' ) '籍贯',
IFNULL( ks.account_type, '' ) '户口类型',
IFNULL( ks.address, '' ) '现住址',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.NAME, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.NAME), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.NAME, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.phone, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1手机号',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.phone), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.phone, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2手机号',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.job, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1职业',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.job), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.job, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2职业',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.card_type, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1证件类型',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.card_type), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.card_type, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2证件类型',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.card_number, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1证件号码',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.card_number), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.card_number, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2证件号码',
IFNULL( SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.relation, ',', 1 ), '' ) '监护人1关系',
if(FIND_IN_SET(',',kg.relation), SUBSTRING_INDEX( kg.relation, ',', - 1 ), '')'监护人2关系',
CASE ks.is_weak WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否高危体弱',
CASE ks.is_only_child WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否独生子女',
CASE ks.is_left WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否留守学生',
CASE ks.is_orphan WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否孤儿',
CASE ks.is_disability WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否残疾儿童',
CASE ks.is_workers WHEN 0 THEN '否' WHEN 1 THEN '是' ELSE '' END '是否务工子女',
IFNULL( ks.NAME, '' ) '学生姓名',
IFNULL( ks.blood_type, '' ) '血型',
IFNULL( ks.nationality, '' ) '国籍',
IFNULL( kks.NAME, '' ) '班主任',
IFNULL( ks.enroll_date, '' ) '入学日期',
IFNULL( ks.place_of_birth, '' ) '出生所在地',
IFNULL( ks.account_quality, '' ) '户口性质',
IFNULL( ks.account_address, '' ) '户口所在地',
IFNULL( ks.special_case, '' ) '特殊情况'
FROM kg_student ks LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, GROUP_CONCAT( NAME ) NAME, GROUP_CONCAT( phone ) phone, GROUP_CONCAT( job ) job, GROUP_CONCAT( card_number ) card_number, GROUP_CONCAT( card_type ) card_type, GROUP_CONCAT( relation ) relation FROM kg_guardian WHERE kg_id = #{exportVO.kgId} GROUP BY student_id ) kg ON kg.student_id = ks.id LEFT JOIN kg_classroom kc ON ks.class_id = kc.id LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks ON kc.teacher_id = kks.id WHERE ks.kg_id = #{exportVO.kgId}
AND ks.class_id = #{exportVO.classId}
AND ks.is_weak = #{exportVO.isWeakQuery}
AND ( kg.`name` LIKE concat('%', #{exportVO.info}, '%') OR kg.phone LIKE concat('%', #{exportVO.info}, '%') OR ks.NAME LIKE concat('%', #{exportVO.info}, '%') )
AND ks.is_leave_school = 0
